text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day during summer camp, while I'm
taking a
nighttime stroll on the beach, I
see Urara talking
with Rice.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Wow. So even you lost during today's scrimmage, Rice?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I just couldn't keep up...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Haru Urara and Rice Shower are in deep

conversation while staring at the ocean.
It seems
like they're talking about
today's scrimmage.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The summer camp's main event is a
group race
where students do a
2,500-meter race in pairs.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, Haru Urara didn't stand a
chance.
As I expected, the distance was
much too long for
her. However...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
But I thought you were great at
long-distance
racing?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I thought so, too. That's why I'm so

disappointed...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I thought I finally found something I'm
good at.
But it looks like I was wrong.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I knew it. I can't do anything right...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What do you mean you can't do
anything
right?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh? W-well, I lost, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: So because you lost once, it's just poof, all gone? You can no longer do anything anymore?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Even though you're still the same person
before
and after the race?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean the old you just poofed
away,
and now I'm talking to a different
person?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: U-um... That's... not quite right...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Then you can still do great things, right?
You're
still a racer at heart!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I... guess so?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
It's true! One loss doesn't mean
anything!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I lose all the time, and I'm still the same old me!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I guess you're right... You're still the
same smiling
Urara...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
See? I lose and I'm still me! So you're
still you too!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
It's important that you do you, in the
way that
you like to do you, and... uh...
Well...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hehe... Thanks. I feel better already.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It'd be rude to continue listening in on
their
conversation, so I turn around to
head back,
when...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
You're really amazing, Urara. No matter
how
many times you lose, you're still
optimistic.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
How can you stay so positive all the
time?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I've been wondering the same
thing.
How does she keep going despite
all those
losses? I wonder if...

text_block_list.name: Kind Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
But that's okay. As long as she enjoys
running...

text_block_list.name: Kind Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
It really pushes us to do our best too.
We're
happy just the way she is.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if she really does just love
running for
the sake of it. And if that's
true, then...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Isn't it obvious?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I wanna win! You can't win if you don't
compete,
y'know?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I want them all to see me finally win!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Who?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
The people from the shopping district,
my
friends... Oh, and my trainer!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
No matter how many times I lose, they
always
cheer me on!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
So once I finally win, I'm sure they're
gonna be
even happier!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: That's why I wanna win! That's why I'm gonna win!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I see. Hehe. That's so like you, Urara.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It all makes sense now. Haru Urara will
never give
up on her dream of winning.
Which means it's
clear what I have to do!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's just me now. Oooh, I feel like
running all
of a sudden!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I'll just do a little extra training for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Trainer! Nice timing!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I was just thinking how much I wanted to
go for a
run! What kind of training
should I do?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Drag a tire?! Gulp...
choice_data_list: Time for tire pulling on the beach!
Beach sprints until the sun goes down!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: R-roger that! Nothing says serious training like dragging tires!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Haru Urara gains a bit of muscle from her
training.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Until sunset?! Th-that's...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Just like the manga Natie was reading!
Let's do it!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna race the suuun!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
From our intense training session, Haru
Urara
learns how to push herself to the
limit.
